title: Retail Installment Contracts: Payment Channel Charges, Card Limit and Certified-Funds-Only Status
content:
**Self-service and autopay.** On Retail Installment Contracts, payments made through the self-service channels — a one-time bank draft or a debit-card payment through the automated phone line, website or mobile app — and autopay carry the tier's self-service payment fee.

**Payments taken by a representative.** A one-time payment taken by a live representative, by bank draft or by debit card, carries the tier's agent-assisted payment fee as a separate agent-assisted payment fee linked to that payment and dated the same day. No agent-assisted fee is charged:

- when the contract state is on the schedule of states exempt from the agent-assisted fee;
- when the payment is a payoff, reinstatement or redemption; or
- when the borrower uses a self-service channel instead.

The representative must state the fee and offer the free channels before taking the payment.

**Debit-card limit.** A single debit-card payment may not exceed the tier's largest debit-card payment; a larger amount is split by the borrower into several payments or made through another channel.

**Certified-funds-only status.** A contract whose fee-bearing returned payments within the last returned-payment restriction window of months reach the tier's returned-payment restriction count is placed on certified-funds-only status. While that status is on, only the channels on the certified-funds channel list are accepted. The status is lifted once the count falls below the threshold. The count is of returned payments whose return reason is fee-bearing, in the rolling 12 months ending on the day measured.

**MoneyGram, wire and certified funds** carry no company fee.

| Payment | Agent-assisted fee charged? |
|---|---|
| one-time debit-card payment taken by a representative, contract state not exempt, ordinary installment payment | yes, the tier's fee |
| same payment, contract state exempt | no |
| same channel, payment is a payoff, reinstatement or redemption | no |
| borrower pays the same amount through the website instead | no agent-assisted fee; the self-service fee applies |

**Hypothetical case.** A contract whose tier's restriction count is 2 has one fee-bearing return seven months ago and a second today: the count reaches 2 and the contract goes on certified-funds-only status, so a mailed personal check is refused while the status lasts. When the older return passes out of the rolling 12 months, the count falls to 1 and the status is lifted.
